notes.title: "Pennon and Battle" confirmed participation in Steam 4X Fest!
notes.notes: [p]Dear lords,[/p][p]We are very pleased to announce: "Pennon and Battle" will be a part of the Steam 4X Fest. [/p][p]During this global game feast focusing on the four major elements of “Explore, Expand, Exploit, and Exterminate”, “Pennon and Battle” will continue to offer a 25% historical low discount! Next, we will bring you a special introduction to the 4X features of “Pennon and Battle”:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000747/3a8cda9212b6556f296221db8938af8274495a63.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Explore the Fantasy Continent[/b][/p][p]On Ruachland, you will lead a team of heroes through the mist, exploring the boundaries of the map. Uncover the secrets of mysterious areas such as the underground lairs of the Ancient Swarm and the emerald forests of the Elven Empire. During exploration, you will have the opportunity to discover treasure maps and treasure detectors, which can guide you to treasures.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000747/02ddab42b6984b1f4d6a8d9b495b2781360fed6c.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Expand the Empire's Territory[/b][/p][p]Start from an initial castle, expand through continuous battles, and gradually build an empire that spans the continent. Different alignments and heroes have unique expansion strategies, either brave in battle or skilled in spells, allowing rapid capture of resource points or erosion of enemy territory.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000747/fbbe99420ca5a4c44b5efe31f4939ec38917b109.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Exploit Resources and Technology[/b][/p][p]Resource management is key to development; collect scattered resources on the map, occupy mines to increase resource output, and research town technology to enhance infrastructure efficiency. The hero's talent tree system also allows you to specialize in areas such as war, economy, and diplomacy.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000747/62122f538a4834e5b3121d21616955baf01805d0.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Exterminate Hostile Factions[/b][/p][p]Extermination is the ultimate clash of strategies; you need to utilize alignment traits and unit advantages in turn-based battles, turning the tide through strategy. Lords can choose to persuade surrender and recruit, or directly eliminate, consolidating the empire's dominance with an iron fist![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000747/b79e999a05a0f9d722be97e8a8ce2ccced6ff3bf.png"][/img][/p][p]Once again, thank you for everyone's support and attention. We welcome everyone to submit valuable suggestions through our official communities, Steam community feedback posts, and various other channels. If you encounter any issues in the game, please prioritize reporting them through the in-game Customer Service Center, as this will help us locate and address problems more efficiently.[/p]

notes.title: Pennon and Battle Version Differences and Pricing Information
notes.notes: [p]Dear Lords, thank you for your attention! Pennon and Battle will officially launch its V1.0 full version on August 7, 2025 (PTD). Don't miss it! Here are the detailed explanations of the game version differences and pricing.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]1. Version Differences:[/b][/h3][p]Purchasing the base game allows you to select 'Standard Mode' on the login screen.[/p][p]Purchasing the base game + Enjoy Mode Expansion Pack allows you to select either ' Enjoyment Mode' or 'Standard Mode' on the login screen.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000747/d115b3311544eec5f63bc65235edd6cb5174d8bf.png"][/img][/p][p]Both modes include the complete game content and modes. Data between the two modes is independent and cannot be connected online. We recommend players choose according to their preferences. Below is the information for each mode:[/p][p]Standard Mode: When you lack Diamonds, you can purchase Gems to substitute for Diamonds. Diamonds can be obtained by completing campaigns, achievements, and daily activities, and are mainly used to refresh certain random elements in the game. Whether or not you choose to use Gems, you can reach the same development cap.[/p][p]Enjoy Mode: Players cannot purchase Gems, but the extra rewards from completing campaigns are increased by 50%, including Diamonds and other development materials such as Aether Crystal, Soulstone Chest, and Event Cards. The chests are related to the Alignment and heroes used in the current campaign, while Event Cards are obtained by chance.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000747/1dc28fc7dff41e8d82446c27c3d43d5e01fcce5f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]2. Pricing Information[/b][/h3][p][b]Discount Information:[/b][/p][p]Players can purchase the game at a historic low discount of -25% during the first two weeks after the full version release (August 7, 2025, 10:00 - August 21, 2025, 10:00). Prices: Pennon and Battle $10.49; Enjoy Mode Expansion Pack DLC: 14.99$.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Price Adjustment:[/b][/p][p]When we launched Early Access in July 2024, we set Pennon and Battle at a relatively low price because we understood the game was not yet complete and needed early supporter feedback to further improve it. After a year of Early Access, the game's completeness and content have significantly improved.[/p][p]To thank players waiting for the full release, we have decided to temporarily keep Pennon and Battle at the EA price, with plans to increase the price two months later. Due to consumption tax in some regions, the specific price increase may vary by region. Please refer to the Steam page for the final price. Players who have already purchased will not be affected. Thank you for your understanding.[/p][p] [/p][p]Thank you for your support and attention! We welcome your valuable suggestions through our official community, Steam community feedback posts, and other channels. If you encounter any issues in the game, please prioritize reporting them through the in-game customer service center, which will help us locate and resolve problems more efficiently.[/p]

notes.title: Pennon and Battle V1.0 Full Release Announcement
notes.notes: [p]Dear Lords,After a year of Early Access updates, the moment to reveal our achievements is finally here! We are thrilled to announce that Pennon and Battle will be leaving Early Access and launching its 1.0 full version on August 7, 2025 (PDT)![/p][p] [/p][p]During Early Access, we iterated through dozens of versions—some planned in advance, many more added based on community feedback. Thank you to every player who joined us on this journey! Here, we'd like to introduce the major improvements made to Pennon and Battle over the past year:[/p][p] [/p][h3]1. Alignment and Town[/h3][p]① Each alignmentSoldier now has 3 promotion branches, allowing direct recruitment of 140 types of soldiers, plus 9 new neutral units.[/p][p]② Each alignment now features 6 unique alignment buildings, newly added Tier 3 Barracks, and Wonder buildings.[/p][p]③ Towns have shifted from linear upgrades to a City Level construction system, making construct buildings more flexible.[/p][p]④ Allied cooperation has been added, allowing you to visit allied towns for certain benefits.[/p][p]⑤ When constructing a spell academy, you can manually set the school tendency to reduce spell randomness.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000747/0dcf4e3e39ea683a05cd4200dbc8b81fd1ab442a.png"][/img][/p][h3]2. Battle Optimization[/h3][p]① Mage's normal attack is now ranged; ranged units can manually switch between melee and ranged modes.[/p][p]② Hero casting timing has been adjusted so that any allied unit's turn can be used, and casting no longer ends the unit's action.[/p][p]③ Units with area damage and War Machinery can Attack empty tiles, dealing splash damage.[/p][p]④ In quick battles, you can choose whether the hero advances, better matching player expectations.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000747/e3d1f177e109a4db2246ec116e6b1a7e194c094b.png"][/img][/p][h3]3. Hero Updates[/h3][p]① 10 new heroes have been added, bringing the total to 55, with adjustments to skill growth methods.[/p][p]② The difficulty of hero development outside of battle has been reduced in various ways; the talent tree now unlocks up to Tier 3 by default.[/p][p]③ Hundreds of artifact effects have been adjusted and updated, with exclusive hero artifacts for each alignment.[/p][p]④ Heroes' Action Points per turn are no longer affected by soldier'sMovement Points.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000747/643ff0deec5c6582dd506dcef71f5879f19cb95a.png"][/img][/p][h3]4. Spell Factions[/h3][p]① Added two new spell factions: Dark spell and Lightspell, increasing the total number of spells.[/p][p]② Added corresponding spell artifacts and hero spell mastery, and improved some units' spell casting effects.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000747/8e5f926889fa6364ea9c245f73611095e1460dd4.png"][/img][/p][h3]5. Game Modes[/h3][p]① Added challenge campaigns and 7 corresponding maps, allowing you to choose from various treaties to challenge enemies.[/p][p]② Added story campaigns, with multi-chapter campaigns for the Elven Empire and Eternight Councilalignments.[/p][p]③ Added tournaments, where both sides nurture epic heroes under the same campaign requirements, who can be brought into tournament battles.[/p][p]④ Online lobby: players can create rooms in the multiplayer lobby and enter campaigns as allies or opponents.[/p][p]⑤ Hotseat mode: up to 8 players can play together on one device, taking turns.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000747/60f0b06e342f16834ab1ae549de8764329cdf165.png"][/img][/p][h3]6. Campaign Adjustments[/h3][p]① Campaign maps now feature 10 settings, including difficulty, map generation, guard units, and AI strength adjustments.[/p][p]② Map editor and workshop are now available, with several large maps added.[/p][p]③ Treasure map gameplay has been added to campaigns; excavating treasures grants high-level artifact equipment.[/p][p]④ Increased the yield of campaign development items, soulstones, and the drop rate of rare event cards.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000747/be42f94ad624bca0e00cf5a13ab08d7bcbb6423b.png"][/img][/p][p]If you are a returning player from earlier versions, we are glad to have your support. As many systems have been reworked, some items and saves may change due to version adjustments. You can claim compensation for these changes via in-game mail. We also recommend starting a new campaign for the best experience.[/p][p] [/p][p]For new players waiting for the full release, we hope Pennon and Battle lives up to your expectations. We recommend purchasing the game at launch, as we will offer a launch discount. With the addition of more content, we plan to increase the price in the future; details will be announced in upcoming news.[/p][p] [/p][p]The full release is not the end, but the beginning of a new journey. We will continue to listen to player feedback as always. Please share your valuable suggestions through our official community, Steam community feedback threads, and other channels. If you encounter issues in-game, please prioritize reporting them via the in-game support center, which helps us locate and resolve problems more quickly. Finally, thank you again for your attention and support! [/p]

notes.title: 'Pennon and Battle' Autumn Sale is Coming
notes.notes:
Lords: 
It's time to embark on a new journey in Ruachland! "Pennon and Battle" will participate in Steam's Autumn Sale from November 27th to December 4th, Pacific Time. During the Autumn Sale, we offer a 10% discount on the "Pennon and Battle" game base and the Enjoy Mode Expansion Pack.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000747/02bd84af454d4050804f68f1c418c6b7c137f61a.png[/img]
If you have already purchased "Pennon and Battle," we sincerely thank you for your support! The game supports multiplayer mode and will launch limited-time challenge events soon. Whether cooperate with your friend or compete with someone, you can experience unique fun in Ruachland!

In the past month, we received feedback from several Lords about the purchase method of the Enjoy Mode, so we plan to change the "Enjoy Mode Expansion Pack" in-game purchase to DLC purchase in the future. And we still need more time for adjustment and modification.  So during this Autumn Sale, the Enjoy Mode will still need to be purchased in-game. Additionally, we have made various optimizations and adjustments to the game based on feedback and added many new contents, briefly introduced below:

[b]Game Modes:[/b]
Added new Challenge Campaign Mode: [Normal] and [Nightmare] difficulty levels.  Lord can choose various restrictions to challenge the enemy's alliances.
Opened [Bloody Moonlit] Chapter 4 ：[Return to Nature] for the test. You will continue to play as the Elf Prince Serlin and embark on a new adventure in the Elven Empire Story Campaign!

[b]Spells:[/b]
Added two new spell series, [Darkness Spells] and [Light Spells], each with 14 spells, including adventure spells and combat spells from levels 1 to 5. Increased corresponding spell book treasures and hero spell mastery, and improved some soldier spell effects.

[b]Town Buildings:[/b]
Added 4 unique buildings for each Alignment, now each Alignment has 6 unique buildings. Some buildings will randomly appear in various towns, bringing different challenges and chances to each battle. Each town can upgrade barracks up to level 3, allowing you to recruit more soldiers! Also, we have fixed some unique buildings for each Alignment to ensure that the unique style of the Alignment persists in random gameplay.

[b]Soldiers:[/b]
Added new third soldier upgrade route for the Barbarian Tribes, Elven Empire, Sacred Oath Alliance, and Eternight Council Alignments, several neutral soldiers! Each new soldier has different effects or gameplay, and you can freely choose and combine them in battles. Some 3D models of new soldiers are still in production, and some temporary resources are used for soldier models in the game, which will be replaced in the future.

[b]New Player Guide:[/b]
Added a guidebook in the game to help new lords get started m. You can learn about the game on the [Settings] > [Game Instructions] page.
We have also improved the game's intelligence station function. Now it not only adds information about the special soldiers but also records spells, treasures, and skills obtained in battles, making it more convenient for lords to check at any time!

[b]Advanced Strategy:[/b]
Soldiers and War Machinery with AoE DMG types can attack the empty tiles now. Lords can select empty tiles as targets, and use AoE DMG to deal splash DMG to enemies more flexibly.
The attack method of ranged units can be manually switched between Melee Attack or Ranged Attack now. It can make Lords flexibly adjust tactics according to changes in the battle situation, and bring a better strategic experience.

We will do our best to develop in future updates and hope to hear your feedback during the early access period, which will greatly help our subsequent development work. You can submit suggestions for "Pennon and Battle" through our official community, Steam community feedback collection posts, and other channels. However, if you encounter game operation issues, we recommend you prioritize feedback through the in-game customer service center, which will help us verify and resolve issues more quickly.

notes.title: 'Pennon and Battle' will participate in the Steam Turn-Based RPG Fest soon!
notes.notes:
My Lord: 
It's time to explore the Ruachland! "Pennon and Battle" will participate in the Steam Turn-Based RPG Fest from September 30th to October 7th, Pacific Time. Enjoy the 10% off of "Pennon and Battle" and the Pure Enjoy Mode Expansion Pack during the event!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000747/78a0d31264abcb4652a5f60a2acef5304acf18ab.png[/img]
If you have purchased the game, we sincerely thank you for your support and hope you can recommend it to your friends. The game supports local co-op of up to 4 players, invite your friends to join "Pennon and Battle" together!

In the two months since the Early Access, we have made a lot of optimizations and adjustments based on feedback and added many new contents. Here is a brief introduction~

[h3]Game Mode:[/h3]
Added a story campaign mode - "Bloody Moonlit", currently updated to the first three chapters: "Nature's Death", "Dragon's Pact", and "Deliverance Operation". The Elves are united and fight for the empire reviving, but the Moonlit Forest is invaded by Orcs due to weak defenses. You will play the role of the Elf Prince Serlin, leading Elves to retreat from the Barbarian encirclement and seek reinforcements to resist Barbarians...

[h3]Game Difficulty:[/h3]
We added difficulty customization for each campaign map, adjusted the initial resources of the campaign, reduced the BOT development speed at lower difficulties, and added many interesting large maps. Whether a new or experienced player, everyone could find a suitable game difficulty and map.

[h3]Heroes:[/h3]
In each of the five alignments, we added two new heroes. It brought the current total number of heroes to 55 in the game, and heroes had different talents and abilities. We hoped that everyone could train their favorite heroes, so we also reduced the difficulty of hero development out of the campaign. Nearly a hundred new hero equipment items were added to the campaign, and heroes could restore status or learn spells when visiting alliance towns.

[h3]Soldiers:[/h3]
We optimized the performances of some soldier's sound effects and skill animations. And now, we are testing new upgrade routes for soldiers of each alignment for continuous updates. As a small studio, we have to take some time for some soldier 3D model productions and use some temporary resources in the game. We will produce and replace them as soon as possible, appreciate your understanding and support.

We will do our best to achieve the roadmap in future updates. Planning to add new spell types, new events in the campaign, new combat units, and more diverse victory conditions. Please stay tuned!

Finally, we really hope to hear your feedback during the early access period, which will greatly help our subsequent development work. You can submit suggestions for "Pennon and Battle" through our official community, Steam community feedback collection posts, and other channels. However, if you encounter game operation issues, we recommend you prioritize feedback through the in-game customer service center, which will help us verify and resolve issues more quickly.

notes.title: Early Access Initial Improvements and Future Plans
notes.notes:
Greetings, my Lord. It has been over a month since the Early Access phase of Pennon and Battle. Thank you for your support and companionship! We've been busy addressing game issues and creating new content, so we may not always respond to your feedback promptly, but we have carefully recorded and discussed each one. We also realized that we didn't have enough communication with players. You may think "What are they doing""What's the future plan of this game" etc. So here it is! Our developer log is created for this.

We have collected a lot of feedback and suggestions from players through Steam forums, social media comments, in-game customer service systems, and official communities. Most reasonable content has been adopted and added to the game, but some content is still under discussion or temporarily shelved due to some objective factors. Here are the initial improvements to the game~

[b]1. Game Difficulty:[/b]
We noticed that some players found the default campaign difficulty too difficult to win on the first playthrough, and the fixed difficulty was not suitable for all players. Therefore, we have added difficulty options for each campaign map, adjusted the initial resources of the campaign, and reduced the BOTs' development speed at difficulties Lv.1 and 2. Players can freely choose the game difficulty according to their preferences.

[b]2. Combat System:[/b]
In the previous setting, Warrior heroes had to be close to the target for a melee attack, but casting a spell would end their turn. We hope that all heroes can use spells to assist themselves in battle, and different classes can experience the strategy brought by spells. So we have adjusted the spells that can be cast at any moment during action, and heroes will no longer end their turn after casting a spell.  We also changed the Mage's normal attack to ranged (not affected by distance decay but lower than melee damage) to differentiate it more from the Warrior and Archer classes.

[b]3. Story Campaign:[/b]
We saw many players in the community suggesting adding more story elements to the game. We are pleased that you compare us to other excellent classic games. Based on the background of Pennon and Battle, we have launched some chapters of the 'Story Campaign,' and the subsequent chapters are also being optimized internally. Your feedback is important for us to make the subsequent content better!

[b]4. Map Exploration:[/b]
We have optimized the functions of some buildings. To improve the early campaign experience, we adjusted the generation rules of 'Sawmill' and 'Mining Site', now they will be closer to the initial town and connected by roads; 'Windmill' and 'Farmhouse' have also removed the random guard setting, reducing the negative experience when visiting with a low combat effectiveness team; we have also added a lot of equipment and items to bring a more experience to players.

[b]5. Town Construction:[/b]
The original construction upgrades were linear, requiring prerequisite construction to upgrade. Therefore, we have adjusted the construction upgrades to Town-level construction. Players can upgrade certain construction according to the current exploration situation, and the construction costs of some buildings have also been reduced. To increase the interaction experience between allies, we have also adjusted the interactivity between allied towns. Now you can visit allied towns to learn their spells and restore heroes status.

[b]6. Other Optimizations:[/b]
Some very enthusiastic players reported that Operational Readiness was consumed too quickly and needed to wait until the next Monday to be restored. Therefore, we have adjusted Operational Readiness to recover daily, with an additional increase on Monday (you can still play normally without Operational Readiness). We have also optimized hero training, reducing the AP requirements for learning talents, and no longer requiring faction materials. Players will be able to experience the unique gameplay of Pennon and Battle more easily. We hope to continue providing high-quality content and services to players, but we also realize that some previous payment methods did not fully consider the player's gaming experience. We have now adjusted some paid content and will adjust the subsequent optimization direction based on feedback. Thank you for your understanding.

In the coming months, we plan to optimize various factors of the game, improve existing systems, and add more gameplay. Here is a rough plan for the short term. We welcome everyone to share their insights, and we will discuss with players which features and gameplay are more favored and try our best to make them come true.

[b]1. Heroes:[/b]
We plan to optimize the skill system, including more unique skills for different heroes and introducing new heroes. The skill-learning rules may be adjusted during this period.

[b]2. Soldier:[/b]
You may have noticed the recent adjustment to the Morale rules, reducing the Morale impact when carrying soldiers from different factions. This is because we plan to bring more Soldier types for each faction. The current 5 factions will have newly promoted Soldiers, and each rank of Soldiers will have more promotion branches, allowing for more Soldier combinations.

[b]3. Spell:[/b]
The spell system will also be further improved. We plan to add more new spell attributes, categorize different spell effects, and continue to add more interesting spells. Some existing spell categories and effects may also be adjusted.

[b]4. New Campaign Gameplay:[/b]
[list]
[*] More Interesting Gameplay: We plan to add new gameplay events in the campaign, such as treasure hunting. There will be treasures of different levels in the campaign, try to find them for high-level equipment or new mysterious items!
[*] Richer Combat Dimensions: Each faction will have new combat units, different from existing heroes, soldiers, and war machines. These units can use their related skills, bringing more strategy and variability to battles.
[*] Diverse Victory Goals: In addition to the existing goal of eliminating all enemies, we are trying to create some non-encounter campaign gameplay, such as surviving for a certain time or creating various challenge-oriented campaign activities based on existing gameplay.
[/list]
[b]5. New Online Experience:[/b]
[list]
[*] Tournament-style PVP: In this new online competitive mode, we plan to restrict the Save/Load function, preventing participants from correcting mistakes through loading saves, making it more competitive. Both sides will cultivate epic heroes under similar campaign requirements and participate in tournaments, with more unique and rare rewards.
[*] Customized PVP: Currently, players in online campaigns can only team up with friends, or match random opponents in the Arena. Considering the need for customized PVP, we plan to open a customized PVP option, allowing players to choose PVP with friends in the campaign and Arena.
[/list]
We will do our best to implement the plan in the coming months. But as a relatively small development team, we may sometimes have to prioritize bug fixes and fall behind schedule or encounter other difficult issues. We also hope to hear your feedback during the Early Access phase. You can submit your suggestions for 'Pennon and Battle' through various channels, but if you encounter game operation issues, we recommend using the in-game customer service center for feedback, which will help us verify and handle them.

After the official release of version V1.0, we will continue to listen to players' opinions and suggestions, constantly improve the game, and continuously update its content. More new factions will not be absent, and there are plans to develop a map and mod editor.

Finally, thank you again for your support and attention to 'Pennon and Battle.' We sincerely hope to present 'Pennon and Battle' in its best form to you. Let's work together to build a more beautiful Ruachland, and we look forward to seeing you next time!

*The above content only represents the current development plan of the game. The mentioned gameplay and features may change during development, and everything is subject to the final online version.

notes.title: Lord, you have a 'Ruachland Exploration Guide' to open!
notes.notes:
Dear Lord: 
Welcome to 'Ruachland,' where countless new generation tribes live, develop, and compete. The Elves' research on 'Aether' has led to rapid civilization development, forming the vast Elven Empire. Other factions are also expanding and emerging... This is the great era for lords, where you will lead your troops to expand territory and create legend in the clash of magic and strategy!

[h3]Faction Introduction[/h3]
Currently, there are five major factions for lords to choose from, each with its characteristics in buildings, heroes, soldiers, and town defenses, suitable for different playstyles. Lords, don't worry too much about faction choice! Heroes from other factions can be recruited during campaigns, and multi-faction soldiers can be combined. I hope my introduction below can answer your questions.

[b]1. Elven Empire[/b]
Elves ally with various creatures of nature, with the ancient Life Tree providing healing abilities. Their magic power is unique in Ruachland, and soldiers have multiple types such as flying, control, and summoning.

[b]2. Sacred Oath Alliance[/b]
A faction combining steam and magic. With powerful mechanical troops and excellent trade capabilities, their troops have abilities like hovering, traps, and repairs, showing strong overall strength on the battlefield.

[b]3. Barbarian Tribes[/b]
They are composed of various barbaric creatures. Building Tribe camps and recruiting soldiers will require fewer resources, and Barbarians can obtain Golden Coins through battles. Soldiers are strong and high in Morale, capable of stunning and repelling enemies.

[b]4. Eternight Council[/b]
Pursuing ultimate magic and eternal existence. The council can convert soldiers from other factions into Eternight soldiers, and revive fallen soldiers. Some soldiers can even distort time and space, becoming a formidable faction on the continent.

[b]5. Ancient Swarm[/b]
The Swarm rapidly expands with terrifying reproduction, infection, and conversion abilities, ravaging every land like wildfire. From low-level insect soldiers to high-intelligence queens, they have a clear division, forming a strict hierarchy.

[h3]Hero Recommendations[/h3]
When the lord first steps into Ruachland, 15 heroes will follow. You can recruit multiple heroes to explore simultaneously. Here are some of the heroes who can become your reliable partners~

[b]1. Jalanil-Elven Empire-Warrior[/b]
Jalanil starts with the Elven Empire's War Machinery-Life Tree, with greatly enhanced healing effects. Thanks to her research on military machinery, she is proficient in Engineering and can operate various War Machinery and enhance their performance. As a battle-hardened ranger Warrior, she gains more experience.

[b]2. Layne-Sacred Oath Alliance-Archer[/b]
Layne comes from a family of hunters, following his father through dense forests and fighting beasts with a hunting rifle. Thus, Layne has developed a stronger physique, higher movement points(MP) on land, and base damage, and can gain considerable experience daily.

[b]3. Freida Guardian-Barbarian Tribes-Mage[/b]
Freida Guardian can collect extra Golden Coins from mines, which is especially important in resource-poor barbaric lands. She initially possesses the [Weakness Laser] spell, effectively reducing enemy attack and defense, supporting her initial ranged soldiers. She can also directly learn level 3 water spells, and reduce terrain consumption.

[b]4. Lunar Lord-Eternight Council-Warrior[/b]
Lunar Lord can steadily gain Golden Coins daily, and the council's 'Soullight Spire' and 'Mystic Recruiting Place' can use Golden Coins to revive or convert soldiers. With Leadership, the Lunar Lord can easily persuade enemies to surrender with fewer Golden Coins, increasing the Morale of his troops for continuous actions.

[b]5. Old Urga-Ancient Swarm-Mage[/b]
When Old Urga is a lord, it will greatly increase soldier production, quickly forming combat power with Swarm's 'Mind Centre' and 'Conversion Core' buildings. Urga can increase soldiers' Luck to deal higher damage, and it also has a larger vision range.

[h3]Combat and Training[/h3]
Heroes will grow continuously during the lord's training, and gain new talents. With a richer combat experience, more heroes will serve the lord. Here are the details of hero combat and training:

[b]1. Exploration and combat in campaigns:[/b]
① The action order in a turn is determined by the Speed of each unit on the field. The fasted units can wait to act at the end of the turn or choose to defend. Troops can move in multiple stages, and flexibly deploy.
② Same soldiers can be combined into a single combat unit or split. Combining soldiers will form powerful single damage, while some soldiers with active skills are suitable for splitting.
③ The number of recruitable soldiers is limited and refreshes weekly. Prioritize upgrading soldier-related buildings, and some town buildings and hero features can also increase soldier production.
④ Transport vehicles can supplement distant heroes' troops and provide vision. They generally have a long movement distance but limited vision range and cannot interact with the map scene.
⑤ Heroes' HP and Mana will be slowly restored every day and can be fully restored in town for one day. The spell will require a magic academy in town to restore, and heroes can cast spells during any ally unit's turn.
⑥ Ranged units have limited Ammo Capacity. After consuming Ammo Capacity, they can only engage in melee attacks. Talents and some buildings can increase Ammo Capacity.
⑦ Horizontally or vertically moving along roads will reduce action point consumption. Sand ground and snow ground will consume more action points. Soldiers are affected by different terrains. They will gain action point bonuses during exploration and attribute bonuses during combat in advantageous terrains.

[b]2. Hero training in campaigns:[/b]
Heroes need to be trained through exploration and combat in campaigns. Heroes will gain EXP by combat to level up and enhance various attributes; they can also gain attribute growth through different buildings or equipment

[b]3. Rewards for completing campaigns:[/b]
After winning a campaign, the lord will receive rewards such as EXP, Talent Points(TP), Diamonds, Aether Crystals, and Intelligence Books based on overall performance. Campaign victory may also grant mission rewards (note: failure campaign will only claim partial rewards, and Talent Points(TP) are obtained by the corresponding heroes used in the campaign).

[b]4. How to unlock heroes:[/b]
Lords can obtain Stellarirs Pieces, Stellarirs Crystals, and Diamonds by completing various achievements. Star fragments and star crystals can be exchanged for most heroes (including Rank 0/1/ 2 heroes) on the Hero page. Some heroes will be unlocked later by collecting hero soulstones.

[b]5. Hero talent training:[/b]
Using the corresponding hero's soulstone or Chaos Soulstone can unlock talent layers for heroes, automatically gaining Awaken Points(AP). Consuming Aether Crystals, Talent Points(TP), and Awaken Points(AP) can activate the hero talent bonuses (note: Chaos Soulstone is a universal hero Soulstone, the talent tree is limited to be activated but can be manually reset).

May the journey in Ruachland bring more fun to the Lords! I am glad to join hands with you to build a more wonderful Ruachland. You must become the most legendary lord in this world!

Sincerely,
Development Advisor-Solana

[b]For reference only, the game may change during early access, and the final version will be based on the actual game situation![/b]

Your internet connection may be unstable or interrupted. Please check your network connection.

If the issue persists, please contact customer service

On the Steam platform, click the "Contact Us" button in the upper right corner of the game login interface to provide feedback.

Single-player campaign: In this mode, you can experience a rich storyline and gradually unlock stages.
Multiplayer campaign: Team up with your friends or online players to challenge a series of campaign missions together.
Arena: This is a PvP (player vs. player) mode where you can engage in real-time battles with other players.

A: Players recharge "Gems" to speed up the out-of-game development process.
All players can reach the same limit in the out-of-game development part.
Players can reach this limit through daily gameplay, whether they recharge Gems or not.

Q2: What payment methods are supported for recharging in this game?
A: The recharge channels for players on different platforms are different.
Players who purchase the game on the Steam platform can recharge through the Steam wallet.
Players who purchase the game on the Luckyee platform can recharge through PayPal, WeChat Pay, and Alipay Pay.

notes.title: Sacred Oath Alliance's spell advisor—Sandar
notes.notes:
In the world of Pennon and Battle, each faction has a unique understanding of the use of source power. The Sacred Oath Alliance of humans and dwarves perfectly integrates machinery with source power spells. The dwarves, with their advanced mechanical craftsmanship, completed the steam revolution early and entered the mechanized era; humans relied on agriculture and commerce for stable development, establishing a united and prosperous nation.

However, the sky remained the domain of birds and dragons. The Sacred Oath Alliance's troops, relying solely on dwarven drills and cannons, were insufficient to deal with aerial threats. At that time, dwarven flying machines were limited by the insufficient power of steam engines, requiring them to reduce size and carry no weapons to lighten the load, which was not suitable for large-scale military operations.

Thus, a wind spell master from the human battle mage corps, after long research and experimentation, successfully used wind spells to improve steam machinery, helping the Alliance's dwarven engineers solve the power issue and further promoting the birth of large flying vehicles, the Air Fortress. This wind spell master is now the spell advisor of the Sacred Oath Alliance—Sandar.

notes.title: Leader of the Betrayers—Destructive Delamin
notes.notes:
In Pennon and Battle, there is a race unknown to other factions—the ancient Swarm. They were severely weakened in ancient wars and have been hibernating underground... until they were awakened by the sound of dwarven drills.
In our setting, the Swarm are servants and experiments of the ancient gods, enslaved by soul binding to fight for them in their quest to conquer all of Ruachland.

But even insects yearn for freedom. Led by their queen, countless Swarm began to rebel against this enslavement, waging war against the ancient gods. Only the Swarm of the Destruction Legion refused to pledge loyalty to the queen, lurking under the ancient gods' command, waiting for the right moment. This earned them the title of traitors among the uninformed. The leader of these traitors is Destructive Delamin.

In the study of Aether spells, Eternight Council and Elven Empire took different paths: The Council leans towards Aether craftsmanship, wielding alchemical creations in their spells; while the Elves are closer to nature, understanding the essence of Aether more deeply.

The story of Pennon and Battle is born in an ancient land called Ruachland. Many tribes have established their own kingdoms on this fertile continent. In the past, the Orc Tribe lived under the powerful Elven Empire. However, with the fall of the Elven Empire, the Orc Tribe finally broke free and gained freedom. But the barren land and their savage nature led them to fight each other. When the barren land could no longer satisfy the Orcs, they began to plunder the fertile lands beyond.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000747/f8caa9e8f13fe5aa322ca6bda2be5d136b6f7858.png[/img]
The Orcs on the barren land are distinctive; they are savage, primitive, and totem-worshiping, skilled in taming various magical beasts. Even their cities are mostly tribal camps. To compete for limited resources and consume excess population, the tribes began brutal wars, with smaller tribes gradually being annexed by larger ones. Apart from some wise Orc leaders reaching a consensus, the main reason is that they have become strong enough to conquer lands beyond the barren land.

notes.title: Elven Empire - The Twilight of the Empire, Reclaiming Past Glory

The story of Pennon and Battle is set in an ancient land called Ruachland. Various races have established their own realms on this fertile continent. The Elven Empire was once the sole ruler of Ruachland, but it declined due to internal strife and division at its peak. Eventually, it disintegrated following a catastrophic explosion caused by the Elves' research into source power. The remaining Elves, though still elegant, yearn for their former glory.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000747/270eb8b85f05f5060a791c3a941db10a86991689.png[/img]
Elves revere Mother Nature. As the early world rulers of the new era, they were proud and confident, establishing a great civilization with high achievements in technology, magic, and arts. However, these are things of the past. Since the mysterious cataclysm, Elven civilization has taken a different path. During the era of conquest, Elves experienced displacement and foreign invasions, becoming cautious and united. They will resolutely fight against nature's enemies until a new Emerald Emperor is chosen. Now, Elves ally with natural creatures, maintaining their nobility, elegance, closeness to nature, and love for magic and archery. Their cities blend with nature. The chapter of Elven revival has begun, and they will restore the empire's former glory.

The cataclysm wiped out most of the Elves' population. To maintain order, the remaining Elves had to ally with natural forces. The Giant Bear and Treant tribes became the backbone of the Elven troops, and the powerful dragons, due to ancient pacts, also became the strongest force in the Elven troops. Elven Empire soldiers possess strong combat abilities, and thanks to the magical powers of the Tree of Life, they can heal and recover during battles, giving them an advantage from the start. Elven Empire heroes have unparalleled achievements in the field of magic, founding many famous magic organizations, making their magic heroes stand out among various factions.

notes.title: Ancient Swarm—Awakened Swarm, Rebels of the Old Gods
notes.notes:
The story of Pennon and Battle is set in an ancient land called Ruachland. Various tribes established their own kingdoms on this fertile continent. Since its awakening, the Swarm rapidly expanded with its terrifying reproductive and infective abilities. By the time the factions realized, it was too late; the Swarm had ravaged Ruachland.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000747/efdc4408528068bb921a9885e79136563ab9aef0.png[/img]
The Ancient Swarm is a peculiar tribe that existed in Ruachland before the last era. They were servants and experiments of the Old Gods. Under the influence of the Old Gods great power, the Swarm possessed strong reproductive and mutative abilities. Their bizarre forms and strict hierarchy created wonders within the species. To control the Swarm as their sharpest weapon, the Old Gods endowed them with psychic powers, allowing the Swarm to coordinate actions within a unified neural network. However, this weapon developed a will of its own. Under the leadership of the Queen, the Ancient Swarm rebelled against the Old Gods. The war was both a success and a failure. Ultimately, the Queen sacrificed herself to free the entire species from the Old Gods' soul-binding, and the heavily damaged Swarm began an endless slumber deep underground. The Swarm's deep sleep was supposed to continue until the new era began, when a group of noisy dwarves drilled into their sleeping lair...

Faction Characteristics:
The Ancient Swarm lurks in the dark underground world, forming a vast and complex community with their nests as bases. The members of this tribe vary greatly, from the lowest ant-like drones to the highly intelligent Matriarchs and elite Warriors, forming a strict hierarchy. Each nest of the Swarm is ruled by a Matriarch, who controls the Swarm through the Spirit link ability granted by the Old Gods.
The Ancient Swarm's Troop consists of various Swarm creatures. Although a single Swarm's combat power is not strong, their vast numbers make up for it. On the battlefield, the most terrifying aspect of the Swarm is their soldier numbers. As they eliminate enemies, countless new Swarms are born, and the Matriarchs continuously hatch larva on the battlefield. The larva born from infection spread like wildfire across every piece of land they pass.

notes.title: Sacred Oath Alliance - Strong economic power, advanced mechanical equipment
notes.notes:
The story of Pennon and Battle is set in an ancient land called Ruachland. Various tribes established their own nations on this fertile continent. The excellent trade capabilities of the Sacred Oath Alliance led to rapid economic growth, allowing them to develop and equip advanced mechanical equipment, making them one of the most competitive factions in Ruachland.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000747/810eb023f38069a002aa6e07627573f9c3d48942.png[/img]
Humans and dwarves are considered young races in the new era, once subservient to the Elven Empire. After the Ruachland catastrophe, the world entered an era of great strife. Human civilization began to flourish, with powerful tribes rapidly growing and transforming. During this period, the great Rickma, wielding the Dragonheart Blade of the Red Dragon Heart Knights, claimed to come to save the world and invented new farming techniques, quickly gaining public support. Eventually, under Rickma's leadership, the seven tribe leaders formed their own kingdom. Shortly after the establishment of the human kingdom, Rickma established diplomatic relations with the dwarf kings in the mountains, forming a new alliance nation - the Sacred Oath Alliance. This civilization, combining steam and spell, quickly became the most united and competitive nation on the continent in the new era.

Faction Features:
The Sacred Oath Alliance showcases its prowess in Ruachland with its formidable mechanical army and excellent trade capabilities. Their mechanical units not only demonstrate strong overall strength on the battlefield but also possess various control and recovery abilities, making the Sacred Oath Alliance capable of both offense and defense in any combat environment, unafraid of any enemy.
The opening of the Treasure Store is the best proof of their trade capabilities. Through trade, they can earn treasures from around the world and convert their own treasures into actual wealth, providing the funds needed for development. This developed trade network not only enhances their economic strength but also gives them an advantage in equipment during wars.
The spell technology of the Sacred Oath Alliance is more integrated with mechanical manufacturing. Although their talent cannot compare to the Elves, they still hold a place in the field of spells, especially wind spells, allowing them to exhibit surprising tactical flexibility when facing enemy forces.
